keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<a href=\"https://example.com/file.pdf\"><img src=\"pdf.png\"><p>Download PDF</p></a>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("keep_inline_images_in" = I(c("a"))), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
